How we rebuilt our search

Last spring our search page was slow. People typed a word and waited. Some gave up. We knew we had to fix it, so we sat down and looked at every step between the key press and the result list.

The first thing we found was simple. We sent a request on every key press. We now wait a short moment before we send it. That one change cut the load on our servers in half.
